departments.CEO: Approve batch expansion targets and authorize hot lead follow-up tokens per recipient.
departments.COO: Enforce daily_batch_cap (25) and ensure no auto-followups trigger without owner token.
departments.CMO: Design batch outreach messaging, sales handoff package, and meeting/demo CTA templates.
departments.CRO: Define hot lead qualification criteria from 1.0Y qualified-interest-summary.json.
departments.CSO: Enforce suppression-check, consent-allowlist, and opt-out auto-mapping for all batch sends.
departments.CTO: Maintain runner, send CLI, premerge simulator, verifier, and auto-loop scripts for 1.0Z.
departments.CFO: Track cost-per-send, provider fees, and revenue pipeline contribution from sales handoff.
departments.CISO: Run pre-send safety scan: no raw emails, no secrets, no tokens in committed artifacts.
departments.CPO: Review batch-recipient-plan.json and batch-outcome-readiness-scorecard verdict before next batch.
departments.CLO: Validate consent source, unsubscribe path, and suppression compliance for each send.

lanes.followup_lane: Process hot leads from 1.0Y follow-up-approval-queue.json. Generate approved-followup-dispatch-plan.json. Send only with OWNER_APPROVED_LIVE_TOKEN matching action_id.
lanes.batch_outreach_lane: Select new batch recipients from allowlist. Default dry-run. Live-send only when explicitly enabled and policy gates pass.
